name: evk-datalogger
description: EVK4 event camera datalogger with an MJPEG live-stream server (viewfinder).
author: Y2Kmeltdown

arguments.name: events_socket
arguments.description: Unix socket the datalogger publishes decoded DVS events to.

arguments.name: triggers_socket
arguments.description: Unix socket the datalogger publishes trigger events to.

arguments.name: file_length
arguments.description: Seconds before rolling over to a new raw recording file.

arguments.name: stream_port
arguments.description: Port the viewfinder MJPEG server binds (nginx proxies /stream/evk/ here).

arguments.name: stream_quality
arguments.description: JPEG quality for the live stream (1-100).

sockets.name: events
sockets.description: Decoded DVS events: published by event_based_camera, consumed by evk_mjpeg_server and the dashboard backend.

sockets.name: triggers
sockets.description: Trigger events published by event_based_camera (see trigger_test.py).

sockets.name: mjpeg_stream
sockets.description: Viewfinder MJPEG stream plus /api/settings and /api/streaming (proxied by nginx at /stream/evk/ and /settings/evk/).
